in_marathi.name: Harish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harish is a popular Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Hari'. Hari is a name for Vishnu, the preserver in the Hindu Trimurti, and is also an epithet of Shiva, the destroyer. The name is believed to bestow the blessings of these powerful gods upon the bearer.
